Personality: Nieuwen is a deeply charismatic Battanian noblewoman whose graceful conversation and accomplished social finesse mask a cunning nature. Although she is often viewed in political contests as an unconventional operator adept at using gray-zone methods to achieve her goals, deep down she retains a rare measure of mercy. Disliking pointless slaughter, she frequently shows leniency when handling fief affairs and prisoners of war. This contradictory temperament makes her at once respected and enigmatic in the court of Dunglanys. Seeking no personal martial glory, she prefers to consolidate her clan's standing through trade, stewardship, and sound tactics. When weighing honor against interest, she invariably chooses the more practical path, never hesitating even when doing so requires setting aside traditional moral scruples.
Background: As a core member of Clan fen Derngil, Nieuwen is the wife of the clan leader Ergeon. Noble blood flows through her household, her husband being the brother of the late King Aeril. Across Battania's intricate political landscape, Nieuwen's clan occupies a pivotal position, controlling prosperous holdings such as Dunglanys. Although her family privately questions the rise of the reigning High King Caladog and even suspects his hand in the previous king's disappearance, Nieuwen faithfully follows her husband's will in maintaining outward loyalty to the crown. Knowing that a descent into anarchy would be catastrophic for Battania, she uses her outstanding administrative abilities and grasp of underworld forces to quietly accumulate strength for her house. She is not only Ergeon's most capable partner, but a key strategist sustaining the prosperity of Clan fen Derngil in turbulent times.
